Loops | Email Platform for SaaS: Marketing & Transactional

segments: A SaaS founder who also owns marketing and needs one workable system for leads, product updates, and lifecycle email
A member of a lean SaaS team trying to communicate with a rapidly growing user base across several email types
A SaaS team replacing separate marketing and transactional email tools with one shared system

business.what_it_does: Loops is an email sending platform for SaaS teams to send marketing, product, lifecycle, and transactional email from one place.
business.business_model: Contact-based subscription with a free plan, paid monthly Growth plans, and custom Enterprise pricing; paid plans have no per-send or team-seat fees.

facts.statement: Loops supports marketing, product, lifecycle, and transactional email from one platform.

provenance.quote: Loops is the email sending platform for SaaS teams. Send marketing, product, and transactional lifecycle email from one place, from waitlist to IPO.

facts.statement: Product workflows can be built around product events for onboarding, trials, and re-engagement.

provenance.quote: Build onboarding, trial, and re-engagement workflows around your product events. Keep contact data current so each email reflects the user’s latest state.

facts.statement: Every Loops plan includes workflows, events, and contact properties.

provenance.quote: Every Loops plan includes workflows, events, and contact properties.

facts.statement: Pricing is based on subscribed contacts, while unsubscribed contacts do not count toward the price.

provenance.quote: A subscribed contact is an email address marked as subscribed. Paid plans are priced by the number of subscribed contacts; unsubscribed contacts do not count toward pricing.

facts.statement: Loops does not charge separate fees for team seats.

provenance.quote: No, Loops does not charge for team seats. You can invite your team without adding a separate per-seat fee to your plan.

facts.statement: Transactional email sending is included at no additional charge on paid plans.

provenance.quote: Transactional email sending is included at no additional charge on paid plans, and the free plan includes up to 4,000 sends in any rolling 30-day window for getting started.

facts.statement: Loops offers official SDKs for Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, Nuxt, PHP, and Ruby.

provenance.quote: These SDKs are produced and maintained by the Loops team.

facts.statement: Transactional email can also be sent through Loops' SMTP service.

provenance.quote: You can also send transactional email using our SMTP service.

facts.statement: AI tools and coding agents can work with Loops through its MCP server, CLI, and agent skills.

provenance.quote: Building with an AI agent instead of an SDK? Connect the Loops MCP server or install the Loops CLI and agent skills.

facts.statement: Loops provides the DNS records needed for sending-domain setup and applies DKIM signing to every outgoing email.

provenance.quote: Loops provides the records you need. You copy them into your DNS during domain setup, and DKIM signing is active from your first send.

facts.statement: Runable reports sending more than 10 million emails through Loops in about a year and a 10% increase in average revenue per user.

provenance.quote: In about a year, Runable has sent more than 10 million emails through Loops and has reported a 10% increase in average revenue per user.

facts.statement: Trails reports that its product-update emails receive roughly 40% opens and more than 10% clicks.

provenance.quote: Trails’ “what’s new” emails see roughly 40% opens and over 10% clicks.

facts.statement: Framer sends all of its email through Loops, including newsletters, product campaigns, onboarding flows, and transactional email.

provenance.quote: Framer sends 100% of its email through Loops, from newsletters and product campaigns to onboarding flows and transactional email.
